JPM.rationale: JPMorgan Chase demonstrates strong fundamental health and positive trajectory. Q1 2026 showed revenue of $49.84B (+10% YoY) and EPS of $5.94 (+17.2% YoY), with Q2 2026 earnings reported at a record $7.70 EPS (up 47% YoY) per the July earnings press release. The bank maintains industry-leading competitive positions: #1 in global investment banking fees with 8.4-9.3% wallet share, top domestic deposit market share, and $5 trillion in assets. Net margin of 31.5% and ROE of 16.2% are strong for a universal bank. Balance sheet equity grew to $364B with a CET1 ratio of 14.3%. On valuation, the stock trades at P/E of 16.2x and P/B of 2.62x, sitting in the middle of its 12-month range (P/E 13.7-17.8x, P/B 2.2-2.8x) — not cheap vs own history but not stretched either. The stock has rallied +13.5% over the past quarter to $350.85, which partially reflects the strong Q2 beat. Near-term catalysts are limited: the next earnings event is October 13, 2026, and while consensus estimates are being revised upward (+7.4% over 30 days), much of the positive Q2 surprise is already priced in.
